summary: Iter 5 bug-fix validation. Backend: 8/8 new tests (decimal coercion + dev_code fallback) PASS, 49/49 regression PASS. Frontend: Signup→Verify→Dashboard auto-fill flow PASS (dev_code callout visible, input pre-filled, lands on /dashboard). Athlete dashboard decimal h/w save (189.5/88.3 → 190/88) PASS — no 422. Forgot-password dev_code auto-fill FAILED — frontend bug: doForgot in App.js does not read dev_code from response.

ui_bugs.issue: Forgot-password flow does NOT capture dev_code from /api/auth/forgot-password response and does NOT pre-fill forgotData.code in step 2. The backend correctly returns dev_code (verified via direct API call), but the frontend ignores it. Review request explicitly required step-2 auto-fill if dev_code present.

action_items: Frontend: In /app/frontend/src/App.js doForgot() step 1 branch, read response and pre-fill forgotData.code if response.data.dev_code present, plus optional yellow callout in the forgot card mirroring VerifyView pattern. Suggested patch: `const { data } = await api.post('/auth/forgot-password', { email: forgotData.email }); if (data?.dev_code) { setForgotData(prev => ({ ...prev, code: data.dev_code })); toast(`Código (e-mail offline): ${data.dev_code}`); } setForgotStep(2);`
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1078 lines — still above recommended 700-line split threshold (carryover from iter 4).
App.js is now 1259 lines — recommend extracting AuthView/VerifyView and DashboardView into separate files.

AthletePayload.height/weight validator silently coerces invalid strings to None (line 200-201). Acceptable for empty strings, but '188cm' would silently become None instead of 422. Consider explicit error for non-numeric non-empty strings.
doForgot in App.js (line 144) doesn't handle dev_code — see action item.
Backend forgot-password correctly returns 200 + no dev_code for unknown email (avoids enumeration) — good security posture verified via test_forgot_unknown_email_no_dev_code.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (signup-verify-dashboard + decimal save PASS; forgot-password auto-fill FAIL; login-403→resend not exercisable in normal flow because /auth/signup doesn't create users.verified=False — only verify creates the user row)

test_credentials: Tests create their own users via /api/auth/signup with TEST_ prefix and clean up via the test_iter5_fixes.py fixture.
seed_data_creation: Per-test ephemeral users prefixed TEST_iter5_*; cleaned in fixture teardown. UI tests used random emails ui_iter5_<ts>@example.com (leftover in db but isolated by timestamp).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 backend bug-fixes (Pydantic field_validator coercing floats and dev_code fallbacks) all verified. The remaining gap is the forgot-password UI auto-fill which needs a small frontend patch in App.js doForgot (~5 lines). Login-403 → resend path is implemented correctly in code (App.js line 129-136) but cannot be triggered through normal signup flow because signup never sets users.verified=False — the user row is only created on /auth/verify with verified=True. To functionally test the 403 path, manually seed a user with password_hash + verified:false via mongosh.
rca of the issue: Frontend doForgot in App.js was not updated alongside doSignup/doLogin to capture dev_code. The backend changes (returning dev_code in /auth/forgot-password response) are correct; the corresponding UI change is missing.
